result.topic_en: Riemann proves that the Dirichlet integral of the real part of an everywhere-finite Abelian integral is positive, deduces that the real part of the quadratic form in the period moduli a_{μ,ν} is negative, and counts the zeros of the theta function on the cut surface S' by integrating d log ϑ.
